method: uniform random draw, seed 20260903, over the 9,086 locations holding at least one candidate row that clears its own mode's bar in headroom.bars; one unit per location, represented by the best-ranked clearing row a seating pass would reach first (solve.ranking under the rank key). No model score chose AMONG the 500 and no head's verdict is prefilled; the population itself is the pool, whose membership is the judge's P(>=4) >= 0.5, so the draw is not score-unconditioned.
why: score_unconditioned is FALSE because the pool bar is a model score, even though the draw within the pool is uniform and seeded. That is the flag failing closed and it costs this batch nothing: what protects the probe's evaluation here is the intra-batch reservation in eval_split.jsonl, not eval-eligibility. anchored is FALSE because nothing on the page is a head's decode — the prefill is a cosine similarity to six locations Matt picked out of the 20260903T234205Z tentative gallery, cut at this sheet's own median, and the page says so in its own words. See data/batch_caveats.md.
